status: reviewed development copper recipe, not manufacturing authorization
rules:
(version 1)
(rule "Signal minimum 0.15 mm" (constraint clearance (min 0.15mm)))
(rule "Graded divider functional 1 mm candidate" (condition "((A.NetName == 'HOT_DIV1' || A.NetName == 'HOT_DIV2' || A.NetName == 'HOT_DIV3') && (B.NetName == 'HOT_*') && A.NetName != B.NetName) || ((B.NetName == 'HOT_DIV1' || B.NetName == 'HOT_DIV2' || B.NetName == 'HOT_DIV3') && (A.NetName == 'HOT_*') && A.NetName != B.NetName)") (constraint clearance (min 1mm)))
(rule "Open contact functional 2.5 mm candidate" (condition "((A.NetName == 'HOT_SWITCHED' || A.NetName == 'HOT_NC') && B.NetName == 'HOT_*' && B.NetName != 'HOT_FB_*' && A.NetName != B.NetName) || ((B.NetName == 'HOT_SWITCHED' || B.NetName == 'HOT_NC') && A.NetName == 'HOT_*' && A.NetName != 'HOT_FB_*' && A.NetName != B.NetName)") (constraint clearance (min 2.5mm)))
(rule "Neutral to low hot circuitry 3 mm" (condition "(A.NetName == 'HOT_N' && (B.NetName == 'HOT_*') && B.NetName != 'HOT_N' && (B.NetName != 'HOT_DIV*') && (B.NetName != 'HOT_FB_*')) || (B.NetName == 'HOT_N' && (A.NetName == 'HOT_*') && A.NetName != 'HOT_N' && (A.NetName != 'HOT_DIV*') && (A.NetName != 'HOT_FB_*'))") (constraint clearance (min 3mm)))
(rule "HOT to isolated all pairs 8 mm preliminary" (condition "((A.NetName == 'HOT_*') && (B.NetName != 'HOT_*') && B.NetName != '') || ((B.NetName == 'HOT_*') && (A.NetName != 'HOT_*') && A.NetName != '')") (constraint clearance (min 8mm)))
